Grainy, high-contrast image reminiscent of a 1960s flash photograph: A young-adult-appearing man with light skin tone and curly, light-colored hair is brightly illuminated from a slightly off-center flash, emerging from beneath a wide-brimmed hat with vibrant, saturated orange and white stripes on the crown and a red brim outlined in yellow. His vertically divided tunic features a saturated blue left side with a yellow sleeve and a saturated red right side with a blue sleeve, cinched by a yellow and blue belt. He wears saturated blue tights and red shoes.

The man holds a thin, golden-yellow object in his raised right hand, catching the bright flash. His left hand rests on a light brown wooden table, also strongly lit by the flash, creating deep shadows underneath. On the table are brightly colored objects: a golden cup, a red cup, several golden coins or discs, two knives (one with a black handle and one with a white handle), and a pouch or bag.

The background is swallowed by deep shadows, hinting at a light yellow ground and a slightly darker yellow horizon line. A small, indistinct green plant or bush is barely visible in the darkness. A subtle vignette darkens the edges. The overall color palette exhibits a warm, slightly yellowish tint, with noticeable film grain throughout.
